notes: Budgets are provisional Phase 2 ceilings, not frozen release budgets.
They are measured against the Debug packed XLL, because the measured operations run through Debug-only hooks. Debug is slower than Release, so a passing measurement is a conservative upper bound.
Every operation under test is read-only. The corpus workbook is never saved.

corpus.description: One input column of constants plus five columns of copied formulas, with a small number of deliberate rule violations seeded at known rows.

privacy.description: A unique marker is written into a formula, a cell value, a defined name, and the worksheet name. After running every Phase 2 operation, the exported diagnostics must contain none of it.
